records.jp: あれ……行き止まり？<CR>ここが最深部ってこと？
records.en_original: A dead end? Does this mean we've reached the deepest part?
records.en: A dead end? Does this mean we've reached the deepest part?

records.jp: 何、あれ……
records.en_original: What's that...?
records.en: What's that...?

records.jp: なんだか……すごくおぞましいもののような……
records.en_original: There's something...scary about it.
records.en: There's something...scary about it.

records.jp: もしかしたら、あれがライムたちの想いが届かない<CR>元凶なのかもしれない
records.en_original: This could be the reason our emotions didn't reach Origin.
records.en: Maybe that is the reason Lime and Yuzu's feelings are not reaching Origin.

records.jp: 一体何なの……？
records.en_original: What could it be...?
records.en: What could it be...?

records.jp: ……調べてくるよ
records.en_original: I'm going to check it out.
records.en: I'm going to check it out.

records.jp: ちょっと、危ないよ！？
records.en_original: But it might be dangerous!
records.en: But it might be dangerous!

records.jp: 少し触るだけだって。<CR>こういうのは、リーダーに任せて
records.en_original: I'm just going to touch it a little. Leave this to the leader!
records.en: I'm just going to touch it a little. Leave this to the leader!

records.jp: これ、私の……。私が元凶ってこと？
records.en_original: This is my... I'm the reason?
records.en: This is my... I'm the reason?

records.jp: あなたは……
records.en_original: You're...
records.en: You're...

records.jp: あなたは何者？<CR>答えはもう、見つけた？
records.en_original: Who are you? Have you found the answer?
records.en: Who are you? Have you found the answer?

records.jp: ……なるほど、私ってことか
records.en_original: So it is me...
records.en: So it is me...

records.en_original: What...
records.en: What...

records.jp: やっと来たね
records.en_original: You finally came.
records.en: You finally came.

records.jp: やっと……？<CR>あ、あなたたちは……？
records.en_original: Finally...? Wh-who are you?
records.en: Finally...? Wh-who are you?

records.jp: きっと答えは決まってるんだろうけど、聞くよ
records.en_original: You already know the answer, but I'll ask anyway.
records.en: You already know the answer, but I'll ask anyway.

records.jp: あなたは何者？<CR>答えはもう、見つけた？
records.en_original: Who are you? Have you found the answer?
records.en: Who are you? Have you found the answer?

records.jp: ……なるほど、みんな私ってことか
records.en_original: You're all me...
records.en: You're all me...

records.jp: この世界でいろんな人と出会った。<CR>いろんな想いを貰って、絆を得た
records.en_original: I've met so many people here. I've made so many memories, and created bonds with all of them.
records.en: I've met so many people here. I've made so many memories, and created bonds with all of them.

records.jp: すべて、私だけの“特別”。私だけの宝物。<CR>だから……
records.en_original: Those things are that special thing I was looking for. They're my treasures.
records.en: Those things are that special thing I was looking for. They're my treasures.

records.jp: 私は、星崎愛央。他の何者でもない
records.en_original: I am Ao Hoshizaki. I'm no one else.
records.en: I am Hoshizaki Ao. I'm no one else.

records.jp: きっとそれでいいんだ
records.en_original: And that's all I need to be.
records.en: And that's all I need to be.

records.jp: でも、そうして得たものすべてを<CR>あなたは捨てることになる
records.en_original: Are you willing to give up everything you've gained?
records.en: Are you willing to give up everything you've gained?

records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: オリジンに想いを届けて作る世界。<CR>それは、あの子たちが望む元の場所に似た世界
records.en_original: A world created from the feelings sent to Origin. A world created in the image of the old world.
records.en: A world created from the feelings sent to Origin. A world created in the image of the old world.

records.jp: そしてそれは同時に、あなたがいた世界でもある。<CR>あなたは、これから作り出される未来から来たんだよ
records.en_original: And yet it is the world from which you originate. You belong to the future of the world that will be created.
records.en: And yet it is the world from which you originate. You belong to the future of the world that will be created.

records.jp: え、じゃあ、私は……元の世界に帰るだけ……？
records.en_original: Wait, so that means... I just go back to my original world?
records.en: Wait, so that means... I just go back to my original world?

records.jp: なら、悩む必要なんてないじゃん！<CR>みんなで私の暮らした世界にいけるなら……
records.en_original: Then I have nothing to worry about! If everyone comes to the world I lived in then—
records.en: Then I have nothing to worry about! If everyone comes to the world I lived in then—

records.jp: あなたはみんなに出会えない。<CR>誰よりもわかってるでしょ？
records.en_original: You will never meet them. You should know that better than anyone.
records.en: You will never meet them. You should know that better than anyone.

records.jp: 生まれ直したあなたは、あなたが知っている通りの<CR>人生を送る
records.en_original: You will be reborn and live the life you've always known.
records.en: You will be reborn and live the life you've always known.

records.jp: 普通に生まれて
records.en_original: Born normally.
records.en: Born normally.

records.jp: 普通に成長して
records.en_original: Grow up normally.
records.en: Grow up normally.

records.jp: 普通に学生になって
records.en_original: Become a normal student.
records.en: Become a normal student.

records.jp: そしてまた……
records.en_original: And then...
records.en: And then...

records.en_original: What...?
records.en: What...?

records.jp: 雫世界にやってきて、世界を創り直し、<CR>すべてを忘れて生まれ直す……その繰り返し
records.en_original: Come to Oasis, rebuild the world, forget everything and be reborn again...and the process repeats.
records.en: Come to Oasis, rebuild the world, forget everything and be reborn again...and the process repeats.

records.jp: あなたがそうすることで、あの子たちの平和な未来が<CR>約束される
records.en_original: By doing so, you will ensure a peaceful future for them.
records.en: By doing so, you will ensure a peaceful future for them.

records.jp: しかしあなたには何も残らない
records.en_original: But there will be nothing left for you.
records.en: But there will be nothing left for you.

records.jp: もう、何度こうして“私”を残してきたんだろうね？
records.en_original: How many times have I left myself behind now?
records.en: How many times have I left myself behind now?

records.jp: ねえ……あなたほんとうに私？<CR>なんでそんなこと知ってるの？
records.en_original: Are you really me...? How do you know all of this?
records.en: Are you really me...? How do you know all of this?

records.jp: ……！　あなたは……
records.en_original: You're...!
records.en: You're...!

records.jp: 「それ」に触れたとき、私は私ではない何かになった
records.en_original: It transformed me when I touched it.
records.en: It transformed me when I touched it.

records.jp: 「それ」は世界を超えた存在。<CR>世界のすべてであり、どこにでも存在するもの
records.en_original: It's something beyond this world. It touches everything in this world.
records.en: It's something beyond this world. It touches everything in this world.

records.jp: だから、「それ」はそこにあった。<CR>そして私が私である限り、必ず私が「それ」に触れる
records.en_original: So it was there too. As long as I am me, I will always be in contact with it.
records.en: So it was there too. As long as I am me, I will always be in contact with it.

records.jp: ……お前もそうだっただろう？
records.en_original: You are the same, aren't you...?
records.en: You are the same, aren't you...?

records.jp: だから、ここで諦めろ。終わらせろ。<CR>それが、お前がこの永遠から抜け出す唯一の方法だ
records.en_original: So give up. End this. It's the only way you will ever escape.
records.en: So give up. End this. It's the only way you will ever escape.

records.jp: ……いやだ
records.en_original: ...I won't do it.
records.en: ...I won't do it.

records.jp: 私は、みんなの想いを未来に繋ぐ！<CR>たとえ私がどうなろうとも！
records.en_original: No matter what happens to me, I'll make sure the others get their future!
records.en: No matter what happens to me, I'll make sure the others get their future!

records.jp: あなたが立ちふさがるというなら、<CR>倒してでも先に進んでみせる！
records.en_original: I won't let you stand in my way!
records.en: I won't let you stand in my way!

records.jp: そっか
records.en_original: So that's how it is.
records.en: So that's how it is.

records.jp: なら、もう語ることは無いね。<CR>――その想い、証明してみせて！
records.en_original: Then there's nothing more to be said. Show me the strength of those emotions!
records.en: Then there's nothing more to be said. Show me the strength of those emotions!

records.jp: 想い、ね……
records.en_original: Emotions...
records.en: Emotions...

records.jp: 想いは理屈に合わないことをさせる。<CR>人間が自らが定めたルールですら平気で破らせる
records.en_original: Emotions make people behave illogically. They lead humans to break even the rules they set for themselves.
records.en: Emotions make people behave illogically. They lead humans to break even the rules they set for themselves.

records.jp: 世界のルールにすら例外をもたらす
records.en_original: Even the laws of the world aren't without exceptions.
records.en: Even the laws of the world aren't without exceptions.

records.jp: いつか、何かの想いがまた、<CR>例外をもたらすかもしれない……
records.en_original: Some day, some other emotion may lead to another exception...
records.en: Some day, some other emotion may lead to another exception...

records.jp: 何を……
records.en_original: What are you...?
records.en: What are you...?

records.jp: ……それじゃあ、始めよう。<CR>――あなたの想い、証明してみせて！
records.en_original: Let us begin. Show me the power of those emotions!
records.en: Let us begin. Show me the power of those emotions!

records.jp: こ、これは……！？
records.en_original: Th-This is...!
records.en: Th-This is...!

records.jp: ユズっ！　ライムっ！<CR>上手くいってるの……！？
records.en_original: Yuzu! Lime! Is everything okay?
records.en: Yuzu! Lime! Is everything okay?

records.jp: わ、分かんない――！
records.en_original: I-I don't know!
records.en: I-I don't know!

records.jp: あれ、ここは…………
records.en_original: Where are we...?
records.en: Where are we...?

records.jp: お、屋上！？
records.en_original: Th-the rooftop?!
records.en: Th-the rooftop?!

records.jp: ななな、なんで！？<CR>あたしたち、戻ってきちゃったの！？
records.en_original: But why?! Why are we back here?!
records.en: But why?! Why are we back here?!

records.jp: いや……いつもの屋上と違う！<CR>これっていったい……
records.en_original: No...this is different from the normal rooftop! What is this...?
records.en: No...this is different from the normal rooftop! What is this...?

records.en_original: Ngh...
records.en: Ngh...

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん！<CR>いったい何があったの……？
records.en_original: Ao! What happened...?
records.en: Ao-chan! What happened...?

records.jp: 会ったんだ。最後の敵と
records.en_original: I met the final boss.
records.en: I met the final boss.

records.jp: 最後の、敵……？
records.en_original: The final boss...?
records.en: The final boss...?

records.jp: なに、あれ……！
records.en_original: What is that?!
records.en: What is that?!

records.jp: あれが、私たちの想いを留めていた元凶だよ
records.en_original: That's what's been stopping our emotions.
records.en: That's what's been stopping our emotions.

records.jp: あいつを倒せば、全部終わる
records.en_original: Once we defeat it, it will all be over.
records.en: Once we defeat it, it will all be over.

records.jp: みんな……ついてきてくれる？
records.en_original: Are you all with me...?
records.en: Are you all with me...?

records.jp: もちろん
records.en_original: Of course.
records.en: Of course.

records.jp: 勝つんでしょ、あれに！
records.en_original: That thing doesn't stand a chance!
records.en: That thing doesn't stand a chance!

records.jp: 勝って、オリジンに想いを届けて新しい世界に行く！<CR>私たちならできるよ！
records.en_original: We'll beat that thing and the world will be remade! We can do it!
records.en: We'll beat that thing and the world will be remade! We can do it!

records.jp: はい！　みんながいれば、きっと大丈夫です！
records.en_original: Yeah! As long as we're together, it will be okay!
records.en: Yeah! As long as we're together, it will be okay!

records.jp: みんな……
records.en_original: Everyone...
records.en: Everyone...

records.jp: （ああ――前にも、こんなことがあったな）
records.en_original: (Ahh, this has happened before.)
records.en: (Ahh, this has happened before.)

records.jp: （そうだ、悩んでる場合じゃない。<CR>私は、みんなの大切な日常を守るために……戦うんだ）
records.en_original: (I need to stay focused...! I have to fight for what matters...to protect everyone's lives.)
records.en: (I need to stay focused...! I have to fight for what matters...to protect everyone's lives.)

records.jp: ねえ、みんな。<CR>最高の夏休みだったと思わない？
records.en_original: This really was the best summer vacation ever, wasn't it?
records.en: This really was the best summer vacation ever, wasn't it?

records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: この世界での暮らし、すっごく楽しかった。<CR>まるで、毎日が夏休みみたいだったなって
records.en_original: Every day I spent in this world was so much fun. It felt just like summer vacation.
records.en: Every day I spent in this world was so much fun. It felt just like summer vacation.

records.jp: でも――それももう、終わりにしなきゃ
records.en_original: But just like summer vacation, it has to end sometime.
records.en: But just like summer vacation, it has to end sometime.

records.jp: 学校でまた、“みんな”と会うために
records.en_original: So that we can all see each other at school again.
records.en: So that we can all see each other at school again.

records.jp: やろう、みんな。<CR>私たちなら――できないことなんて、何もない！
records.en_original: Let's do this! As long as we're together, there's nothing we can't do!
records.en: Let's do this! As long as we're together, there's nothing we can't do!

records.jp: 帰ろう。私たちの日常に
records.en_original: Let's go back to our regular lives!
records.en: Let's go back to our regular lives!

records.jp: 終わらせよう――私たちの、夏休みを
records.en_original: It's time for summer vacation to end.
records.en: It's time for summer vacation to end.
